findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_activity_codes, get_activity_code, list_wilayas, list_jo_years, list_jo_issues, get_jo_issue, search_jo_titles, get_vat_regimes, get_support_schemes, search_jo_text, get_jo_act, list_communes, list_dairas, get_commune, search_post_offices · Private data: search_activity_codes, get_activity_code, search_anae_activities, list_wilayas, get_wilaya, list_jo_years, list_jo_issues, get_jo_issue, search_jo_titles, customs_tariff_sections, customs_tariff_chapters, creation_legal_forms, calculate_casnos, calculate_ifu, get_tax_rates, get_social_contributions, list_institutions, get_tax_calendar, get_support_schemes, search_jo_text, get_jo_act, search_tax_code, list_communes, list_dairas, search_post_offices, list_countries · Public sink: get_jo_act, list_communes, list_dairas, get_commune, search_post_offices.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_activity_codes, get_activity_code, list_wilayas, list_jo_years, list_jo_issues, get_jo_issue, search_jo_titles, get_vat_regimes, get_support_schemes, search_jo_text, get_jo_act, list_communes, list_dairas, get_commune, search_post_offices · Private data: search_activity_codes, get_activity_code, search_anae_activities, list_wilayas, get_wilaya, list_jo_years, list_jo_issues, get_jo_issue, search_jo_titles, customs_tariff_sections, customs_tariff_chapters, creation_legal_forms, calculate_casnos, calculate_ifu, get_tax_rates, get_social_contributions, list_institutions, get_tax_calendar, get_support_schemes, search_jo_text, get_jo_act, search_tax_code, list_communes, list_dairas, search_post_offices, list_countries · Public sink: get_jo_act, list_communes, list_dairas, get_commune, search_post_offices

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_jo_act" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
